categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in semiconductor testing and packaging services, including wafer probing, IC testing (logic, memory, mixed-signal), burn-in testing, and turnkey services. It also provides wafer grinding, cutting, die sorting, and packaging services. The business covers integrated circuit testing for various applications such as AI, HPC, automotive, IoT, and wireless communication ICs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced semiconductor testing technologies including logic test machines, image sensor test machines, MEMS testing, burn-in ovens, and probe card storage systems. It integrates automated and intelligent manufacturing processes, employs AI tools for test program automation, and develops proprietary test equipment and software. The production process includes wafer probing, grinding, cutting, die sorting, IC testing, burn-in, and packaging with strict quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are semiconductor design companies (fabless), integrated device manufacturers (IDMs), and foundries primarily in the AI, HPC, automotive electronics, and consumer electronics sectors. The company serves global semiconductor markets, supporting high-performance computing chips and emerging AI applications. Major customers include well-known semiconductor design and manufacturing firms with long-term stable relationships.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with additional subsidiaries and investments in China (Suzhou) and overseas branches in the USA, Singapore, and Japan. It plans to establish production bases outside Taiwan to diversify supply chain locations. Sales are predominantly export-oriented, with approximately 68% of revenue from international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream semiconductor supply chain, specializing in outsourced semiconductor testing and packaging (OSAT). It provides critical backend services between wafer fabrication and final product assembly, focusing on testing and quality assurance of semiconductor devices.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include focusing on high-end semiconductor testing for AI and HPC chips, expanding advanced process product testing, and enhancing automated and intelligent manufacturing capabilities. R&D efforts target development of high-frequency testing, silicon photonics, MEMS device testing, and proprietary test equipment. The company emphasizes innovation, intellectual property protection, and integration of AI in test solutions to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service fees for semiconductor testing, packaging, and related backend processing services. The company also earns income from technology licensing and equipment sales related to its proprietary test solutions. Revenue growth is driven by increased demand for AI and HPC chip testing services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks seventh globally among semiconductor packaging and testing service providers, competing with major players such as ASE, Amkor, JCET, and others. It maintains a stable market share by leveraging comprehensive test capabilities, quality, delivery speed, and cost advantages. The company benefits from long-term customer relationships and a broad product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$26.856 billion, an 11.94% increase from the previous year, with a gross margin of 34.79%. Net profit and earnings per share grew significantly, supported by strong AI-related demand. The company has a solid financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio of 48.44% and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers integrated semiconductor testing and packaging services with a focus on high-quality, timely delivery, and cost efficiency. Its proprietary test equipment and AI-enhanced solutions provide differentiated technical capabilities. Long-standing customer trust, comprehensive service offerings, and continuous innovation in advanced testing technologies position it as a reliable partner in the semiconductor supply chain.
